mcl-core.subject: Core registry, six currently implemented Tier-0 reference semantics, C validator, and release packaging

layer_status.mcl-core: Provisional semantic normalization assignments and opcode registries, with six currently implemented Tier-0 reference semantics. C validator with overflow and truncation hardening.
layer_status.mcl-wire: Freestanding C99 reference codec. Bit-level encode/decode for 6 Tier-0 semantics. Extension framework present. Randomized fuzz decode. Known test vectors. Zero heap allocation.
layer_status.mcl-link: C99 reference state machine (9-state lifecycle, context install/authorize/compare, wire major mask without narrowing) plus the Link frame v0 canonical layout: 8 bytes minimum, flag-selected destination/session/sequence/freshness/CRC-32 integrity, strict rejection of unknown version, unknown frame class, reserved flag bits, truncation and integrity failure. This is the carriage unit every transport binding maps onto.
layer_status.mcl-sdk: C99 reference SDK. Node init/reset, Tier-0 send/receive over raw Wire bytes, and a framed contact path over Link frames for the IP/BLE/UWB bindings. Transmit sequence advances only on transport success; a session reference requires an installed context; malformed frames are rejected before semantic decoding; reception has zero side effects on link state. Zero heap allocation, caller-owned buffers.
layer_status.mcl-ap: Analytical channel model (ISO 9613-1); Experiment 001 (LAB/EXPERIMENTAL hosted binary FSK testbed, frozen at 3/5 kHz as the instrument holding the E3 result); Experiment 002 part A (real transducer path characterization); Experiment 003 (band-informed AP-B0 candidate, 3/6 kHz, with a same-session control and a reverse-direction E4 result). No normative profile. AP-B0 NOT selected. Protocol-facing Wire, Link, and SDK libraries remain freestanding C99.
layer_status.mcl-ip: Reference implementation. Endpoint offer with family-consistent address sizing and an opaque local reference so first contact need not force address disclosure; datagram carriage where the datagram boundary is the frame boundary; length-prefixed stream carriage that preserves synchronisation across an undecodable frame; MTU accounting. Freestanding C99, no sockets, no libc symbols.
layer_status.mcl-ble: Reference implementation. Fixed-size endpoint offer; explicit fragmentation and reassembly for the 20-byte default ATT payload, with START/END/sequence framing that discards rather than splices on loss, reordering, orphaned continuations or restart; connectionless presence confirmed to fit 31-byte advertising data. Freestanding C99, no Bluetooth stack, no libc symbols.
layer_status.mcl-uwb: Reference implementation. Fixed-size endpoint offer; one Link frame per UWB data frame; ranging-evidence record that deliberately exposes no verified distance and no proximity-proved flag. Admissibility as proximity evidence requires performed ranging, a drift-cancelling method, authenticated scrambled timestamps and moderate radio confidence; overflow in distance conversion is refused rather than wrapped. No distance bounding is implemented or claimed. Freestanding C99, no UWB driver, no libc symbols.

C0_static_registry.detail: semantic-codes-v0.2.json validated by tools/validate_registry.c with overflow and truncation hardening.

C1_canonical_encoding.detail: 6 Tier-0 semantics encode/decode bit-perfectly. Known test vectors retained in mcl-wire/tests/test_vectors.c.

C2_negative_decoding.detail: Truncated, malformed-opcode, noncanonical-padding, and oversized inputs tested. Randomized fuzz_decode exercised.

C3_link_state_tests.detail: 9-state lifecycle transitions, context install/reject in forbidden states, wire major mask boundary (0..UINT32_MAX), context compare.

C4_independent_interoperability.detail: No independent implementation exists to test against.

C5_ap_physical_profile_conformance.detail: No normative AP profile defined; AP-B0 is not selected. Analytical model, experimental lab testbed, and measured path characterization only. Transport binding carriage mappings for IP, BLE and UWB are implemented and unit-tested, but no binding has been exercised against real hardware.

C6_device_ecosystem_robustness.detail: No multi-transport or ecosystem-scale testing performed. Only the acoustic binding has run over real hardware.

E0_analytical.detail: ISO 9613-1 attenuation, spherical spreading, Doppler, serialization time, bitrate-equal-to-propagation. Boundary conditions tested (distance=0, negative, payload=0).

E1_deterministic_simulation.detail: Experiment 001: Binary FSK 300 baud, 48 kHz mono PCM, 4 preamble candidates (LFM chirp, Zadoff-Chu derived, PN m-sequence, frequency-diverse) evaluated with exact length invariant (N=4800, 0.1s), verified 7-bit m-sequence (period 127), equalized energy budgets, quadrature correlation magnitude, and preliminary small-sample empirical Pfa threshold calibration (target Pfa=0.010, exactly 100 noise trials per candidate). Corrected impairment harness with explicit enablement: measured AWGN power verified across 30, 20, 10, 5, 0 dB (at 0 dB SNR, noise power equals signal power within 0.5% and P_d=1.000, 12/12 payload CRC valid); post-filter colored noise power measured and scaled to requested SNR (30, 20, 15, 10, 5, 0 dB); band attenuation verified via pure sine probes (3000, 3800, 4000, 4200, 5000 Hz) with measured center notch attenuation of exactly -10.00 dB at 4000 Hz; hardened RIFF WAV chunk scanner and strict format rejection. Experiment 001 is a host-side research testbed using hosted C math/stdio/WAV; the protocol-facing Wire/Link/SDK C libraries remain freestanding C99. Experiment 003 adds a band-informed candidate that changes only the FSK mark tone (5000 -> 6000 Hz) on the measurement from Experiment 002 part A; against a same-session 3000/5000 control it took exact recovery from 0/10 to 9/10 on the DFR1154 receiver and 0/10 to 4/10 on the laptop Realtek receiver.

E2_replay.detail: Retained physical capture evidence/e3-dfr1154-20260902/capture-005-crc-verified.wav (DFR1154 ESP32-S3 PDM microphone, 48 kHz PCM16 mono, board CRC-32 DF6E6D65 verified host-side) replays through the offline decoder to valid frame CRC 0x219A, exact Wire bytes 00 02 00 00 00 01 01 00 00 01 3C, and exact PRESENCE semantic recovery. This required a receiver change made after the capture (symbol-boundary rounding rather than truncation), so it is replay evidence only and does NOT establish E3. Retained same-laptop Realtek captures still achieve no recovery.

E3_controlled_over_air_frame.detail: First over-air recovery of an exact MCL frame. The hashed source exp001_e3_source.wav was played through the laptop Realtek speaker and captured by the DFR1154 ESP32-S3 onboard PDM microphone at 48 kHz PCM16 mono, returned over native USB CDC with board-side IEEE CRC-32 verified host-side. Ten trials taken against the frozen receiver after the symbol-boundary rounding change, decoded with no further modification: 10/10 preamble acquisition (correlation 0.874086 to 0.877460), 10/10 PHY header recovery, 8/10 exact Wire bytes and exact PRESENCE semantic object. A separate 3-trial pilot under identical conditions recovered 3/3, giving 13 trials with 13/13 acquisition and 11/13 exact recovery. Both failures acquired cleanly and decoded all 24 header bits correctly, failing only on payload symbols; the measured cause is transducer response, the PDM microphone attenuating the 5 kHz mark tone approximately 12.4 dB relative to the 3 kHz space tone and leaving roughly 0.3 of log-energy decision margin on the weakest end-of-frame symbols. Evidence, per-trial table, and SHA-256 manifests are retained in mcl-ap under experiments/001-known-waveform/evidence/e3-dfr1154-20260902-frozen-rx and -frozen-rx-pilot. Same-laptop Realtek microphone attempts still achieve no recovery. This is single-operator, single-device-pair, short-range evidence; it is not multi-device (E4) and does not select AP-B0.

E4_multi_device.detail: First multi-device over-air recovery, in the reverse direction from E3. The DFR1154 MAX98357 amplifier and onboard speaker transmitted the Experiment 003 candidate frame (FSK 3000/6000 Hz) and the laptop Realtek microphone array received it: 10/10 preamble acquisition at correlation 0.883-0.889 and 8/10 exact Wire bytes plus exact PRESENCE semantic recovery; a 3-trial pilot recovered 1/3. Neither transducer is shared with E3 and the emitting device is now the embedded one. Acquisition on this path (0.883-0.889) is far stronger than laptop-speaker to laptop-microphone measured the same day (0.35-0.53) with the same microphone, which separates transmitter from receiver response and confirms the Experiment 002 finding that the notch is in the laptop speaker. Evidence in mcl-ap under experiments/003-band-informed-candidate/evidence/e4-board-speaker-to-laptop-mic-20260902/. Limits: the 3000/6000 pair was chosen from a forward-path sweep and this reverse path has not been swept; two physical devices in reversed roles rather than a third independent device; one operator, one room, one geometry, one session; AP-B0 remains NOT selected.

codebase_status.summary: All eight repositories now contain implementation, not only specification. 20 test targets pass across the family under strict warnings-as-errors.
codebase_status.freestanding_verification: Link, Wire, SDK, IP, BLE and UWB objects compiled and inspected for undefined externals: no memcpy, memset, malloc or stdio. Byte copies use a volatile-destination helper because optimising compilers rewrite plain indexed loops into memcpy, which would reintroduce a libc dependency.
not_implemented: No transport binding has been exercised against real IP, BLE or UWB hardware.
No independent implementation exists, so C4 and E6 remain unreachable.
AP-B0 is not selected and no acoustic profile is normative.
